title: Owner-preserving primitive dual-square actual-symbol transfer
objective: Derive the complete two-step transform of the literal polynomial-q M2 row, with every actual owner and error retained, and decide whether the returned odd-character square yields the full D-saving, a strict polynomial subrange, or an exact equal-capacity reassembly.
exit_gate: A complete owner-preserving transform theorem plus a full-D estimate or strict polynomial subrange, or a rigorous owner-by-owner equal-capacity return with the smallest remaining actual-vector correlation.
